title: Memory Bank Seed Entry List
description: Canonical local file format used by scripts/preload_memory.py (--facts-file) and scripts/load_memory.py (--dry-run --local-file). Each entry maps to one pre-extracted fact that Memory Bank's direct_memories_source / GenerateMemories or CreateMemory API can consolidate or store. Grounded in the Agent Platform Memory Bank API (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/scale/memory-bank/api-quickstart and https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/scale/memory-bank/generate-memories) as of 2026-09-11 -- re-verify field names against those pages before depending on this for a production seeding pipeline, the API is still evolving.

fact.description: The memory content, written in first-person perspective to match Memory Bank's default generation perspective (e.g. 'I live in Austin, Texas.' not 'The user lives in Austin, Texas.'). See references/long_term_memory_patterns.md for why perspective consistency matters for consolidation quality.

scope.description: Scope dict this fact belongs to, e.g. {"user_id": "123"} or {"user_id": "123", "session_id": "456"}. Max 5 key-value pairs, no '*' characters (reserved for filter wildcards). If omitted, the script falls back to the --scope-json CLI flag applied uniformly to every entry in the file.

topic.description: Informational label only -- one of the managed topics (USER_PERSONAL_INFO, USER_PREFERENCES, KEY_CONVERSATION_DETAILS, EXPLICIT_INSTRUCTIONS) or a custom topic label configured on the target Memory Bank instance. Direct pre-extracted facts are NOT re-classified against topics the way conversational extraction is -- this field is for your own bookkeeping/filtering of the seed file, not enforced by the API on write.

metadata.description: Optional structured metadata map using the API's typed-value wrapper, e.g. {"source": {"string_value": "onboarding-doc"}, "confidence": {"double_value": 0.9}}. Supported value keys: string_value, double_value, bool_value, timestamp_value. See references/vertex_memory_bank_api.md for metadata_merge_strategy (MERGE default, OVERWRITE, REQUIRE_EXACT_MATCH) which controls how this interacts with existing memories during consolidation.
